title: Database disk full from runaway export job
alert: Customers can browse the shop but placing orders fails with 'Something went wrong'; the admin export page times out.

truth.root_cause: A new data export job runs every minute and writes large CSV files to /var/lib/postgresql/exports, filling the 50 GB database disk so PostgreSQL cannot write new data.
truth.fix: Move the largest export file from /var/lib/postgresql/exports to the root disk to free space, disable the runaway export job, then verify orders work again.

recent_changes: Deployed continuous data export job (pg_export every minute to /var/lib/postgresql/exports/)
